newsitem.title: USA: Vastar, Southern set marketing venture.
newsitem.headline: Vastar, Southern set marketing venture.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said Tuesday it and Southern Co will combine their natural gas and power trading and marketing operations to create a full service energy provider.

The new company, Southern Co Energy Marketing LP, will be one of only a handful of energy service companies in the U.S. that is a top-10 marketer of both natural gas and electric power based on first quarter 1997 volumes, it said.
The venture -- which is expected to begin gas marketing September 1, and power marketing upon receipt of regulatory approvals -- will be 60 percent owned by Southern.

It will be managed by Vastar and Southern Energy Inc, a unit of Southern Co, which will commit its Atlanta-based energy marketing and trading operations -- Southern Energy Trading and Marketing -- to the venture. Vastar will contribute substantially all the operations of its Vastar Gas Marketing Inc and Vastar Power Marketing Inc subsidiaries.
Vastar said the venture is subject to execution of final agreements between the two companies.
Under the proposed terms, Southern would pay Vastar an initial cash payment of $40 million and have the ability to increase ownership over a five-year period.
Vastar said the arrangement will provide it a minimum estimated present value of $280 million with an opportunity for substantial upside for both parent companies.
In connection with the venture, Vastar said it expects to enter into a long-term natural gas purchase and sale agreement with Southern Co Energy Marketing.

Under terms of the proposed agreement, Vastar would commit to sell substantially all of its gas production at market-based prices, providing the venture a base load of committed gas supply to support its marketing.

Marce Fuller, senior vice president for Southern Energy's North American operations, will serve as chief executive officer of Southern Co Energy Marketing. Day-to-day operations will be handled by managing directors W. A. "Andy" Lang -- currently president and CEO of Vastar Gas Marketing and Vastar Power Marketing -- and Joe Pokalsky, currently a senior vice president with Southern Energy Trading and Marketing.
Southern Co Energy Marketing intends to provide competitively-priced energy commodities to a customer, while also offering value-added products such as energy and risk management services.

"This is an opportunity for both Southern Co and Vastar to improve their positions in the energy trading and marketing business," said A. W. Dahlberg, chief executive of Southern Co. "This venture is consistent with Southern Co's plan to be one of the top five energy marketers by the turn of the century."
Vastar said plans call for the natural gas trading and marketing operations to be located in Houston, while the electricity trading and marketing and corporate headquarters will be in Atlanta.
